issueFound.summary: The grass native-packet contract used descriptive/legacy strings for two automatic-fail mappings instead of the canonical IDs consumed by visual_fidelity_gate.json.
issueFound.risk: A local grass integration QA could report its failure mapping as complete while the strings did not identify the actual canonical automatic-FAIL entries. That semantic disconnect is unacceptable for fail-closed evidence gating even though it did not itself award Visual Fidelity points.

commits.effect: Updates the machine-readable grass native-packet contract to schema 1.1.0, uses exact canonical automatic-FAIL IDs, records visual_fidelity_gate.json as the authority, and declares forbidden legacy aliases.

commits.message: Bind grass failure IDs to visual gate
commits.effect: Cross-parses visual_fidelity_gate.json, rejects blank/duplicate/unknown mappings, requires the exact grass-relevant canonical set, and rejects the two legacy aliases.
